rationale: C22 provides a concrete template built around intervening events eliminating the need for pending legislation: it first explains the bill and underlying legal situation, then identifies newly enacted general legislation, and concludes that the private bill is "no longer necessary." The child follows the same distinctive progression, explaining the requested delay, noting that funding was subsequently enacted, and concluding that the extension is "no longer needed." This is materially stronger than shared veto-message boilerplate. C17 and C14 have some similarities in discussing alternative or subsequent legislative solutions, but neither matches the child's changed-circumstances/no-longer-needed structure as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Since Congress passed the bill, however, the funds required for the implementation of the Federal Boating Act have been included in the Mutual Security Appropriation Act, 1960.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have signed into law the Technical Amendments Act of 1958 which contains general legislation designed to grant nondiscriminatory relief to all taxpayers in the same situation as Mr. and Mrs. Moore.
shared_material.explanation: Both identify legislation enacted after the bill's underlying problem arose as having supplied the needed solution.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Consequently, the extension of time provided in the bill is no longer needed.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Since general relief is now available, this private relief bill is no longer necessary.
shared_material.explanation: The conclusions use closely parallel causal language to reject a bill because an intervening enactment has made it unnecessary.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This legislation was originally considered necessary because it had not been possible to obtain a supplemental appropriation for the Coast Guard to administer the new system.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: At this time the statute of limitations barred refunds to Mr. and Mrs. Moore and to a substantial number of other taxpayers similarly situated.
shared_material.explanation: Each establishes the original obstacle before explaining that subsequent legislative action removed it.
